rules: Preserve existing repository assets unless a change is required for a verified fix or migration.
Prefer additive upgrades over destructive rewrites.
Search existing registries before creating a new record so aliases and duplicates are not created unnecessarily.
New ideas may be invented proactively when they improve capability coverage, reliability, safety, cost, usability, monetization, interoperability, or maintainability.
Mark ideas as proposed until implementation evidence exists.
Mark implementations as certified only after applicable tests pass.
Treat international and non-English ecosystems as first-class discovery targets.
Use shared runtimes and registries where possible instead of duplicating near-identical source modules.
Never reduce the existing bot, company, capability, or library inventory merely to simplify the architecture.
continuous_discovery_lanes: missing AI model and provider records
new AI products and developer tools
new combinations of existing DreamCo capabilities
